actions.title: Decide observed candidates
actions.summary: Atomically accept or reject exact observed review bases with audit. Accept means verify, not source parity.

actions.title: Prepare project
actions.summary: Automatically prepare, compare, and recover without a wall-time limit by default. Optional finite budgets and per-function attempt limits remain available. Completion is not proof.

fields.name: maxMcpToolCalls
fields.help: Optional nonnegative MCP tools/call cap, including prerequisites, retries and checkin. Omit for unlimited measured dispatches; resume retains spending.

fields.name: maxActionAdmissions
fields.help: Optional nonnegative initial action-admission allocation. Omit for unlimited accounting. Resume preserves the existing allocation and spending.

actions.title: Bind compared knowledge
actions.summary: Bind accepted matches without rebuilding existing identities. Fill missing source attribution while retaining human metadata.

actions.title: Adjust automatic workflow
actions.summary: Pause, resume, stop, or adjust workflow limits. Budget controls wall time; admission-budget revises root action admissions; provider-budget revises MCP tools/call dispatches. Both require the preparation to drain and the current allocation revision, and retain spending. Accepted native operations drain before stopping.

fields.name: maxMcpToolCalls
fields.help: New total MCP dispatch allocation for provider-budget; spent intents are retained.

fields.name: maxActionAdmissions
fields.help: New total allocation; previously spent admissions are retained. Use unlimited=true explicitly to remove the cap.

fields.name: expectedAllocationRevision
fields.help: Required current revision of the selected admission-budget or provider-budget; stale revisions are refused.

actions.title: Read workspace activity
actions.summary: Read entity activity, progress, queue state, and receipt-backed evidence.

actions.title: Inspect retained resource ownership
actions.summary: Read a job's retained ownership and missing clearance evidence without releasing resources.

actions.title: Reconcile committed resource release
actions.summary: Repair stale reservations only from an already committed same-attempt terminal local clearance receipt. Unknown work remains reserved.

actions.title: Download binary source ZIP
actions.summary: Export whole-program decompiled C and available source witnesses with an inventory and coverage manifest. Compilation and byte verification remain separate.

actions.title: Commit similarity signatures
actions.summary: Import generated BSim signature XML without opening a Ghidra project.

actions.title: Compile and verify candidate
actions.summary: Compile one source draft with an operator-owned preset and compare its object with objdiff. Job completion or compile success alone is not byte proof.
